decision.rationale: A moving sedan brakes hard in flowing traffic while the ego follows at a normal headway and responds after a human-like reaction delay.
A moving sedan briefly hard-brakes in the ego lane and then resumes, creating a late but avoidable rear-end conflict on an ordinary posted-speed corridor.
The ego approaches a genuinely stopped sedan at the tail of a queue on an ordinary posted-speed corridor, with a late response producing a critical but collision-free rear-end trace.
